title: Sparkly teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <!-- top-left sparkle -->
    <line x1='15' y1='15' x2='15' y2='6'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='15' x2='6' y2='15'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='15' x2='9' y2='9' stroke='#fff176'/>
    <!-- top-right sparkle -->
    <line x1='85' y1='15' x2='85' y2='6'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='15' x2='94' y2='15'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='15' x2='91' y2='9' stroke='#fff176'/>
    <!-- bottom-left sparkle -->
    <line x1='15' y1='85' x2='15' y2='94'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='85' x2='6' y2='85'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='85' x2='9' y2='91' stroke='#fff176'/>
    <!-- bottom-right sparkle -->
    <line x1='85' y1='85' x2='85' y2='94'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='85' x2='94' y2='85'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='85' x2='91' y2='91' stroke='#fff176'/>
    <!-- small circles -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='90' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='90' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066' stroke='none'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#e0a856'/>

  <!-- Bear belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f0c880'/>

  <!-- Bear head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='16' fill='#e0a856'/>

  <!-- Bear ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='9' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='5' fill='#f0c880'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='9' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='5' fill='#f0c880'/>

  <!-- Bear muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f0c880'/>

  <!-- Bear eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Bear nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2510'/>
  <!-- nose shine -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='42' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#8a6a40'/>

  <!-- Bear mouth -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 51 54 47' stroke='#3a2510' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Bear arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#c8873a' transform='rotate(-20 26 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#c8873a' transform='rotate(20 74 62)'/>

  <!-- Bear legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c8873a'/>
  <!-- paw pads -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='85' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f0c880'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='85' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f0c880'/>
</svg>
